messages:
Alex W: Hey infra — opened a PR to add an order_history table + backfill job. Needs DB SRE eyes before we run the backfill. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123. TL;DR: new table, index on (order_id, created_at), backfill ~12M rows in batches. Can someone review for safety and give a runtime estimate?

DB SRE: Looking. Quick q: is the backfill idempotent and resumable? Also prefer we run during a low-traffic window. Any long locks?

Alex W: Yes idempotent — uses cursor pagination + checkpointing in job_state. Backfill writes with upserts. No table locks; index created with `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`. Config: `BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE=5000`. Plan: 1) create table + index concurrently, 2) deploy backfill job as separate deployable, 3) run backfill, 4) switch reads and drop old columns later.

Tanya R: Can you split into discrete migrations so we don't hold anything long? create table/index first, then run backfill as a separate change/ops step.

Alex W: Yep — PR contains three migration files following that pattern. Index sql: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_order_history_on_order_created_at ON order_history (order_id, created_at);` Backfill triggered via `scripts/run_backfill.sh` which respects `JOB_CHECKPOINT_ID`.

CI Bot: CI status — unit tests passed ✅, integration infra tests unstable (failing flaky `order-processor` test).

Samira: I'll take a look now. One question: are we setting `user_id` NOT NULL? If source has nulls the backfill could drop rows.

Alex W: Good catch — backfill currently filters out `user_id IS NULL` rows and records them to `migration_audit`. We'll only apply `SET NOT NULL` in the final migration after we verify audit. I'll add that explicit verification step.

Micah: DB SRE here — I can schedule the backfill for tomorrow 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Rough estimate 2–3 hours given current row size; we should plan for up to 4. Need a runbook in the PR with rollback steps and monitoring checklist.

Alex W: Added a runbook and rollback SQL snippet to the PR (see the last commit). Also requested reviews: @Samira @Tanya R for code, @Micah for schedule/ops.

Samira: :thumbsup: left a small comment about sanitizing the dynamic SQL builder — please address before merging.

Tanya R: LGTM pending that fix. @Micah are you okay with the proposed window?

Micah: Yes, schedule works. If job runtime > 4h we pause and reevaluate. Also monitor replication lag; if lag > 30s abort and notify.

Alex W: Thanks everyone — will push the fix, wait for the +2 approvals, then merge ahead of the scheduled run. Will ping again when it's ready to start.
